whyItMatters: A script that runs during install or build executes with the developer or CI identity, before any test or review has looked at the code. This rule reads a `config.allow-plugins` switch that allows every plugin.
actions: Move the step out of the install lifecycle into an explicit, reviewed command that the build runs on purpose. Specifically: fix a `config.allow-plugins` switch that allows every plugin.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm composer.json no longer carries a `config.allow-plugins` switch that allows every plugin.
